title: Bad quality
text: Bad quality. I opened the box to check it out and realized the quality was not as expected.  The side of the cup had bumpy ridges not shown in the pictures.  The lid does not fit the cup at all!  It leaves a gap on the side and wobbles around. The inside of the cup was not well made because there are little holes and dents everywhere.  The box the cup came in was very nice, however the cup and lid itself was bad quality.
